source_selection: primary focal S-N or strain-life study with lawful stable PDF
explicit material/specimen, loading mode, stress or strain definition, R ratio and frequency
table or supplementary data distinguishing failures from run-outs
independently reviewed ownership, evidence locator and checksum before activation
scientific_boundaries: preserve stress amplitude versus stress range and maximum stress; never relabel one as another
pair each failure cycle count with its own specimen and applied amplitude
a run-out is censored, not a cycles_to_failure observation
a fatigue limit is admitted only if explicitly reported by authors with its definition
S-N points require source_table or supplementary_data series provenance
do not fabricate numerical points from an undigitized figure or fit line
model predictions and cited comparison curves are separate from focal experiments
offline_result: 20/20 selected assertions; all 60 table rows recovered; 19 run-outs remain censored
live_result: after the historical three provider_unavailable attempts, the authorized closure retry returned a frozen schema-invalid payload; raw full-gold score 0/20, deterministic recovery 20/20
activation_gate: controlled live benchmark completed; no quality retry authorized
